title: Restriction of set-valued sheaves to a small pro-etale site object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in universe $\mathcal U$ and let $U\to X$ be an object of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For set-valued sheaves in the value universe of that site, define $\operatorname{res}_U:\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(U_{\mathrm{proet}})$ by precomposition with the structure-map composition functor $c_U:U_{\mathrm{proet}}\to X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $(V\to U)\mapsto(V\to U\to X)$. Thus $(\operatorname{res}_U F)(V\to U)=F(V\to X)$, restrictions on site arrows are those of $F$, and a sheaf morphism is restricted by the same precomposition. This is a sheaf functor because $c_U$ is continuous. No covering, quasi-compactness, nonemptiness or Noetherian hypothesis on $U\to X$ is required.
